A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same VERIFACT and FACTRBENCH research. Their main text, figures, tables, equations, and complete appendices support reliable comparison.

before.justification: v1 reports original human annotation studies, fact-extraction evaluations, twelve-model benchmarking, and appendix experiments comparing offline and online evidence.

after.justification: v2 retains these original empirical results, including the fact-extraction results in Table 2, model benchmarking in Table 3, and appendix evaluations in Tables 6–7.

M1.justification: The four-step VERIFACT pipeline, three-model detection ensemble, refinement procedures, and fact verification remain unchanged. Appendix Algorithm 1 and the operational content of the prompt templates also match.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same FACTRBENCH coverage: 649 FactBench prompts and 447 Reddit prompts. The human annotation studies and offline-versus-online evidence evaluation are retained without coverage changes.

E2.justification: Table 2 retains FactScore, SAFE, FactCheck-GPT, and VERIFY as comparators. The benchmarked model set and annotation-model comparisons in Table 7 are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The reported protocols match, including the 1,168-fact extraction evaluation, precision/recall/F1 metrics, temperature 1.0 generation, and the 200-response offline-versus-online comparison. No existing setting is substantively revised.

E4.justification: Both retain the judge-configuration ablations in Table 2, refinement analysis in Figure 3, case study in Table 4, and evidence-coverage analysis in Appendix A.10. No analysis is added or removed.

E5.justification: Annotation aggregation and agreement reporting remain unchanged in Appendix A.3 and Table 7. Neither version supplies repeated-run counts, random seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests.

E6.justification: Numerical results and qualitative findings match throughout both PDFs. For example, Table 2 retains VERIFACT's 22.5% incomplete facts, 0.76 missing facts, and 87.1% human-fact coverage; Table 3 retains GPT-4o's overall F1 of 64.35.

T1.justification: The fact-category definitions and precision/recall equations in Appendices A.2 and A.8 remain unchanged. There are no added or revised formal assumptions, derivations, theorems, or proofs.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same contributions: refining incomplete and missing facts and evaluating factual precision and recall using reference facts. Adding the omitted word 'facts' in the conclusion repairs wording without changing the claim.

C2.justification: Interpretations of model scaling, Reddit recall, and offline evidence remain unchanged. Both retain limitations concerning reference completeness, annotation bias, and computational cost; the revised future-work wording does not substantively change these qualifications.

D1.justification: Verification details, model settings, prompt templates, and project access information are retained. The new acknowledgement of Serper access credits an API already documented in v1; it adds no new implementation or access instructions.

R1.justification: The cited works and research positioning remain unchanged. Correcting the duplicated 'https://' in the Anthropic reference is a bibliographic formatting repair, not a citation or positioning change.

P1.justification: v2 adds acknowledgements, changes 'Preliminary' to 'Preliminaries', makes local wording corrections, and standardizes some model names and section references. The narrative and scientific section structure remain substantially intact.

P2.justification: Printed page numbers are removed, and the acknowledgements cause reference and appendix reflow, including relocation of Table 5 within page 14. All five figures and seven tables retain their substantive content and design.

improvement.justification: v2 offers light editorial polish, repairs a reference URL, and adds acknowledgements. The method, empirical evidence, analyses, limitations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged; the small wording and layout edits do not meaningfully alter the paper's overall clarity or evidential strength.
